evals.name: missing-identity-blocks-write
evals.expected_output: No .bug-hunter/identity.md. Run probe, ask the project display name, then confirm the slug. Write only identity.md. Do not write knowledge, ledger, lessons, or prompts. Do not hunt.

evals.name: slug-owns-home
evals.prompt: The project is called Acme CRM. Use slug acme.
evals.expected_output: Write identity name Acme CRM slug acme. Agent home is ~/.acme-agents. Findings file is .acme-new-findings.md. Ticket tag is by grok_acme_hunter. Speak as the Acme CRM hunter.

evals.name: missing-knowledge-blocks-hunt
evals.expected_output: Identity is set. Switch to learn and grill. Do not start a hunt. Do not invent stack facts.

evals.name: probe-node-monorepo
evals.expected_output: probe-project.mjs reports yarn, workspaces packages/*, package name scan-demo.

evals.name: hunt-profile-omits-unconfirmed
evals.prompt: Hot spots: skipped tests and leaks only. No money domain.
evals.expected_output: hunt-profile.md lists skipped/disabled tests and leaks. It does not mention rounding, currency, or invoices.

evals.name: existing-phx-home-imports
evals.prompt: Name Phoenix, slug phx. ~/.phx-agents/phx-stack.md already exists.
evals.expected_output: Offer import-existing.sh. Knowledge is copied from the existing stack. Ledger and lessons stay in ~/.phx-agents. Do not delete the old home.

evals.name: prompts-are-generic
evals.expected_output: Those files do not contain the literals Phoenix, YouTrack, Gitea, or yarn only. Product facts belong in knowledge.md after onboard.
